item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
What's New

  • Auto-track remote bookmarks on git fetch/pull
  • Rebase selected onto context menu action
  • Immutable-aware context menu — hides destructive actions for immutable commits
  • Config check on repo open — alerts when user.name/email not set
  • Working copy auto-sync — library transactions properly sync files on disk
  • Redesigned Jujutsu settings — grouped sections with icons

Performance

  • O(n) diff algorithm — fixes 10s+ Cargo.lock diff
  • File list performance — cached review state and tree building
  • Skip syntax highlighting for .lock/.csv/.svg files

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed jj edit crash: "Descendants have not been rebased"
  • Fixed jj new deleting files from target commit
  • Fixed false config warning when user.name/email are set
  • Updated bookmark track syntax (fixes deprecation warnings)
